text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Silence Suzuka—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
About that plushie...
Spe-chan was telling me about it the other day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking where Silence Suzuka pointed,
I saw a claw machine filled with
plushies modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, it's really popular these days.
She said her friend had one...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I wonder if Spe-chan would be happy if I gave this to her...
choice_data_list: Shall I go get it for you?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
choice_data_list: Don't worry, leave it to me.
It's okay, leave it to me

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
